protocol.retraining: first calendar day of each month; expanding targets from 2024-01-29 through preceding day, complete lag windows only
protocol.availabilityAssumption: previous calendar day aggregate available before prediction
protocol.selection: lowest 2024 common validation MAE; fixed candidate insertion order for ties; 2025 never used to select
protocol.missing: null; any missing/nonpositive lag in prior 28 calendar days causes abstention; missing/nonpositive target excluded
protocol.comparison: all four statistical baselines and selected ML on identical dates
protocol.coverage: prediction availability on observed days; not prediction interval coverage
protocol.peakMetric: sum(max(actual-prediction,0)) / sum(actual) on days >= training P90

model.residualDefinition: target minus prior four same-weekday median; add median back at prediction
